title: DelegationPackage
description: Worker-specific execution policy nested under Task.delegation (ADR 0012). Generic work fields such as objective, constraints, context refs, expected output, sender/recipient, priority, deadline, and parent task identity belong to Task and are intentionally not duplicated here. Workers may not delegate further in v0 (ADR 0009).

granted_permissions.description: Must be a subset of the manager's own permissions, further restricted for this task (least authority).

output_contract.description: Worker-specific result contract layered on top of the standard worker_result.schema.json envelope.
